title: Browser semantic-adapter parity
summary: Swing should match the semantic action/value rules of the first-party Alchemy Wire UI JS renderer even though its presentation toolkit differs. Display conveniences must not widen authority-bearing action detail.
invariants: CHOICE_LIST server identity fields such as saleId remain string identities, not checkbox booleans.
Actionable collections return only index plus recognised server identity rather than echoing the whole display object.
FORM/TOKEN_FORM/CHOICE_LIST rich composition uses semantic Continue submission rather than deriving action text from a display label.
Typed field hints may affect presentation/accessibility but Wire values remain exact strings unless the semantic contract says otherwise.
Human-facing cell labels/titles/names are display data and do not become authority data.

provenance.claim: First-party browser semantic action/revision seam used as cross-renderer parity reference.
Qualified Swing browser-parity rules for bindings, rich forms and action payload narrowing.
